correctness.rationale: Three exhaustive positive-probability location cases yield the exact normalized moment polynomials. The contrast derivative has the strictly positive quadratic factor \(10(t-3/4)^2+3/8\), giving global injectivity and the integrated inverse estimate. The first-moment derivative \(t(5t-4)/4\) gives exact fiber multiplicities, and epsilon/2epsilon witnesses show the \(1/2\) stability exponent is optimal. A self-contained verifier passed 22414 tests including exact rational case identities and shortest-path numerical quadrature; finite checks supplement, not replace, the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A geometrically canonical first cyclic network with a dangling branch has a complete inverse low-moment classification given measured total arclength. Exact first-moment two-shape ambiguity, second-moment resolution, unique mean minimizer and optimal square-root instability form a substantive and motivated boundary for geometric recovery from pairwise travel distances. These claims are not a numeric table entry, arbitrary parameter slice, or just substitution of a forward formula. The result does not purport to handle complex networks or finite-sample statistics.
